html:
Detailed Itinerary Of The Tour

16:00: Our tour guide will pick you up and transfer you to our bicycle store, where you will choose a suitable bike. After a short briefing about the itinerary, we will start riding along the Red River bank, passing the Opera House and the Ceramic Road.

We then visit Long Bien Bridge and a quiet island where farmers grow vegetables and fruits, followed by a visit to a local market. After that, you will enjoy an amazing ride to West Lake, where we can admire the panoramic view of the sunset. This is a great place for beautiful photos.

From there, we continue riding to Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, the 1,000 year old Citadel and B52 Lake, where a military aircraft was shot down and has remained in the lake since the war. We also cycle past some of Hanoi’s most famous landmarks such as Train Street, the French Quarter, and the Old Quarter.

After the ride, we return to the Old Quarter to enjoy dinner at a famous local street food restaurant, where you will taste traditional Vietnamese dishes. Then you will try the iconic egg coffee before being transferred back to your hotel.

Tour Includes

  • Mountain bikes

  • Experienced English-speaking cycling tour guide

  • Street food dinner

  • All entrance fees and bottled water

  • Free pick-up and drop-off

  • Rain poncho (if needed)
